Variable description: Heating degree days. Monthly-mean-LST-derived heating indicator: D * max(65 - LST, 0), where LST is in degrees Fahrenheit and D is the actual number of calendar days (degree-Fahrenheit days).
Data source: Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), NASA (https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/MODIS_061_MOD11A1)

Variable description: Cooling degree days. Monthly-mean-LST-derived cooling indicator: D * max(LST - 65, 0), where LST is in degrees Fahrenheit and D is the actual number of calendar days (degree-Fahrenheit days).
